description: Source code for a distributed elastic agent API in PyTorch, managing worker processes, rendezvous, and event logging.

classes.name: WorkerSpec
classes.description: Defines the specifications for a worker role, including entrypoint, args, and rendezvous handler.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents an individual worker instance with ranks and identifiers.

classes.name: WorkerState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible states of a worker group, such as HEALTHY, FAILED, etc.

classes.name: WorkerGroup
classes.description: A set of Worker instances managed together, with associated state and metadata.

classes.name: _RoleInstanceInfo
classes.description: Data class used for exchanging role and rank info among agents.

classes.name: RunResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of running a worker group, including success/failure and return values.

classes.name: ElasticAgent
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing distributed worker processes.

classes.name: SimpleElasticAgent
classes.description: Concrete implementation managing a single WorkerGroup, with methods for rendezvous, start, stop, and monitor workers.

methods.name: get_entrypoint_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the entrypoint, function or binary.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Post-initialization validation and warnings for WorkerSpec.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes role, rank, and local_world_size info into bytes.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into a _RoleInstanceInfo object.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two _RoleInstanceInfo objects based on role and rank.

methods.name: find_role_boundaries
methods.description: Finds start and end indices for a specific role in a list of role info objects.

methods.name: is_failed
methods.description: Checks if the WorkerState is FAILED.

methods.name: get_worker_group
methods.description: Returns the WorkerGroup managed by the agent.

methods.name: _start_workers
methods.description: Starts workers for a WorkerGroup (abstract).

methods.name: _stop_workers
methods.description: Stops workers in a WorkerGroup (abstract).

methods.name: _monitor_workers
methods.description: Monitors workers and returns RunResult (abstract).

methods.name: _shutdown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, optionally sending a death signal (abstract).

methods.name: _rendezvous
methods.description: Performs rendezvous for a WorkerGroup, assigning ranks and updating store.

methods.name: _assign_worker_ranks
methods.description: Determines and assigns ranks to workers, using environment variables and store info.

methods.name: _initialize_workers
methods.description: Starts a new set of workers for a WorkerGroup, performing rendezvous and starting.

methods.name: _restart_workers
methods.description: Stops and restarts workers in a WorkerGroup.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to run the agent, handling retries, monitoring, and shutdown.

methods.name: get_event_failed
methods.description: Constructs an event indicating failure.

methods.name: get_event_succeeded
methods.description: Constructs an event indicating success.

methods.name: _record_worker_events
methods.description: Records events for each worker based on RunResult.

methods.name: _get_worker_state
methods.description: Determines the string state of a worker based on RunResult.

methods.name: record_duration
methods.description: Context manager to record duration of an operation.

methods.name: _construct_event
methods.description: Builds an Event object with metadata about worker or agent state.

methods.name: _record_metrics
methods.description: Records metrics related to the run result.

methods.name: _record_metric_with_condition
methods.description: Records a metric with a boolean condition.

methods.name: _record_flakiness_metric
methods.description: Records a flakiness metric based on retries and failures.

methods.name: _invoke_run
methods.description: Executes the main run loop, including starting workers and monitoring.

methods.name: _exit_barrier
methods.description: Implements a barrier to wait for all agents to finish.

methods.name: _construct_event
methods.description: Constructs an event with detailed metadata for logging.
